description: Raw rows for questions the report does not answer. search_console (default): rows for any dimensions, each with the previous period and the change, from web search or with search_type from image, video, news, Discover or Google News; page and query narrow to rows whose URL or query contains that text; page_regex, query_regex and exclude_query_regex take RE2 regexes for custom cuts. google_analytics: landing pages for visits from search, with Google Analytics’ own metric names. bing: Bing Webmaster query or page rows (first dimension) for the same site, by week. clicky: landing-page visits, traffic sources and search engines from a Clicky site the person saved (site is its domain or Clicky site ID; at most 31 days). simple_analytics: landing-page visitors, referrers, utm_source tags and AI tools from Simple Analytics with the API key the person saved (site is its domain).

detail.description: summary first. rows: the next page of rows. full: every field as JSON.

dimensions.description: search_console, default query (page for discover and google_news); bing uses the first, query or page.

exclude_query_regex.description: search_console only: RE2 for queries to leave out, such as the brand.

offset.description: rows only: the first row to return.

page.description: search_console only: URL text, such as /blog/.

page_regex.description: search_console only: RE2 the page URL must match.

query_regex.description: search_console only: RE2 the query must match.

search_type.description: search_console only. web (default) is the All tab; image, video and news are the Images, Videos and News tabs; discover is the Discover feed; google_news is the Google News app and site. discover and google_news have pages but no queries or positions.

site.description: search_console and bing: the property or site. google_analytics: numeric property id from seo_sites. clicky: the site or its Clicky site ID. simple_analytics: the site domain.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; without end_date it runs to the latest final day.

name: seo_data
title: Raw rows
